market.title: Big Brother Season 28 Winner
resolutionNote: Resolves to whichever houseguest is named the winner on the live finale, currently set for a 90-minute special on Thursday, Oct 1, 2026 - the last one standing takes home the $750,000 grand prize.

Kalshi's own wording: "If [houseguest] are officially declared the winner of Big Brother Season 28, then the market resolves to Yes." Kalshi and Polymarket both list every houseguest as a separate Yes/No contract rather than one multi-choice market, so each name's price is its own independent read on the field, not a slice of a fixed 100%.
Only the 5 real contenders by current price are tracked here out of 17 total houseguests - the rest are sitting at a nominal 1-2% on both platforms with no realistic path to the money.

text: Big Brother 28 (subtitled 'Time Trip') premiered on CBS on July 9, 2026, with a cast of 14 first-time players plus three surprise returning-format houseguests: Survivor winner Dee Valladares, Survivor alum Rick Devens, and past Big Brother player Angela Murray.
Dee Valladares has led the winner market on both Kalshi and Polymarket since the season's early weeks, currently priced around 26% - Rick Devens is the clear second choice in the mid-to-high teens.
The 'Time Trip' twist has scrambled alliances more than a normal season, which is part of why the market has stayed volatile week to week instead of settling on one runaway favorite.

Prediction markets have become a genuine spoiler problem for reality TV this season - Kalshi's contestant pricing has, in past seasons, tipped off eventual winners and eliminations well before they aired, to the visible frustration of shows like Survivor and The Bachelorette.
